question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Dreadful
solution:
The correct answer is '**Terrible**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here's the explanation: 
 
 
• **Feeble** (दुर्बल) - lacking physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness.
 
• **Terrible** (भयानक) - extremely bad or serious; causing terror or fear.
 
• **Auspicious** (शुभ) - conducive to success; favorable.
 
• **Propitious** (अनुकूल) - giving or indicating a good chance of success; favorable.
 
 
 
• Sentence using the correct synonym: *"The **dreadful** storm caused widespread damage to the coastal areas."*
 
• Explanation: The word "**dreadful**" means causing great fear or terror. Among the given options, "**terrible**" is the **most appropriate synonym **as it shares a similar meaning to "**dreadful**." "**Feeble**" means **weak and lacks the intensity conveyed by "dreadful."** **"Auspicious" **and **"propitious"** have **positive connotations, opposite to the negative sense conveyed by "dreadful."**
